sections.title: Whose free time?
sections.content: In A1 you learned szabadidőben with no owner named, just "in [one's] free time". Now add a possessive suffix to idő before -ben, so you can say whose free time it is: szabadidőmben (in my free time), szabadidődben (in your free time), szabadidejében (in his/her free time).

items.english: What do you do in your free time?
In his/her free time, he/she gardens.

sections.content: idő becomes idej- before the 3rd person possessive suffix (idő + je = ideje, "his/her time"), the same kind of stem change you saw with fiú -> fia. That's why it's szabadidejében, not szabadidőjében.
